composition.gooo_source:
package indexed
namespace indexed9361
entity Integer id "urn:gooo:type:integer"
entity Input id "urn:indexed9361:input" fields {
 field values id "urn:indexed9361:values" type integer required many
 field order id "urn:indexed9361:order" type integer required many
 field position id "urn:indexed9361:position" type integer required one
}
entity Output id "urn:indexed9361:output" fields {
 field item id "urn:indexed9361:item" type integer optional one
}
activity Seed(Input) -> Input id "urn:indexed9361:seed" computes "return input"
activity ByValue(Input) -> Integer id "urn:indexed9361:value" computes "return input.values[input.order[input.position]]"
activity ByAddress(Input) -> Output id "urn:indexed9361:address" computes "return Output{item: &input.values[input.order[input.position]]}"
bind Seed.result -> ByValue.input
bind Seed.result -> ByAddress.input
composition.scope: source-declared typed value graph; finite activity selection and independently compiled graph execution are separate observations

read_observation.scope: successful scalar collection index and range reads; input element identity is preserved through slice views, record copies, binds and helper calls; constructed collections remain unresolved; scalar arithmetic is not tracked as element identity

input_separation.scope: unique root-input tuples; actual inputs at graph activities and constructed helper calls compared with source output/condition/holdout cases and recorded probes; all supplied expectations across duplicate rows must match; model-training exposure is unknown

runtime.scope: two fresh compiled value-graph executions; finite named expectations; explicit edges and ordered actual values; zero inference during replay/execution
